concept: One continuous sponge-painted world, one unbroken take, one plain man. In Turkish 'gün' is both day and sun, so each day is a sun on one dotted course: yesterday's slips from his hand and sets at the left; tomorrow's is only a dashed ring in mist at the right; today's is unveiled directly above him and life blooms on the rise where its light falls. Then the day is counted out as 24 hour-beads on a dial, one turns gold, floats down and is minted into a coin in his palm, and where tomorrow's fog was the true future rises as pure light against a deepened sky. Its light sets up a little wooden coffer that is revealed to be a mosque - or a prayer rug - and with a half-step toward it he casts the hour into the rug's glowing niche; niche, doorway and far light answer one after the other. Above him the day's dial keeps its one gap: one hour of the day went there.
visual_grammar: What is real and yours is fully sponge-painted and stencil-solid (today's sun, the hour-coin).
What is not yours is only a dashed stencil outline over bare primer (tomorrow's sun, its title-deed).
What is gone dabs out and breaks into drifting specks (yesterday's sun, the deed).
What is unseen but certain is pure soft light with no hard edge, painted against a deepened sky (the true future).
One glowing pointed arch appears four times: chest seam / lock plate, mosque doorway, mihrab niche, and the shape of the far light itself.
One kind of stencil dot marks every path: the course of the days (deep ochre) and the descent of the far light to the chest (warm white with a brick rim).
The hour keeps its identity to the last frame: two clock-hands on the coin, and above him the dial with one bead missing and its hand pointing at the gap.

dynamism.rule: Kurzgesagt's measure and not more: ONE clear picture idea per clause. Everything else inside a clause is anticipation or follow-through of that idea; at most two frame-synced hits per phrase.
ideas: The call arrives at him: 'my own self'.
Bil ki dünkü gün senin elinden çıktı.
Yesterday is a sun he thinks he holds; it slips out of his hand and sets.
Yarın ise senin elinde senet yok
Tomorrow is only an outline; you hold no deed to it.
So then: the veil opens - today was above him all along.
Your real life: light pours on the one rise he stands on, and life blooms there.
The day you are IN: only where he stands is lit - and he takes it to heart.
The day is counted out as 24 hours; one of them turns gold.
The hour lands in his palm and is minted into a coin - money put by.
The true future: a steady light rises where tomorrow's fog was.
Its light sets up a little chest within reach - a chest that belongs to the hereafter.
...or a prayer rug: the same chest in its nearest form.
He casts the hour - and it reaches the true future.
dynamism.note: 14 ideas in 23.4 s (about one every 1.6 s), after a short opening in which the painter's hand finishes the world. Everything else inside a clause is anticipation or follow-through of its idea. Frame-synced hits are capped at two per phrase - the idea and its resolution; the two clauses that hold two phrases («Yarın ise | senin elinde senet yok», «teşkil olunan | bir sandukça-i uhreviye») carry three. 28 of the 47 words have a hit of their own (revision 1: 38).

layout.coordinate_system: WORLD px = frame px of the HOME framing (camera cx 540, cy 960, zoom 1). A camera {cx, cy, zoom} puts world point (cx, cy) at the frame centre: screen = [540 + (x - cx) * zoom, 960 + (y - cy) * zoom]. This is the engine's camera {x: cx, y: cy, zoom}. Everything the man touches or that must line up with him lives on the subject plane (parallax 1.0) and obeys that formula. Parallax layers (sky, clouds, far ridge, mist, far light) are given in LAYER px: at HOME they sit exactly at those coordinates; in other framings use E.worldToFrame(cam, parallax, x, y). Where a parallax layer must line up with a subject-plane element in a particular framing, that framing's screen px are given too. All screen numbers in this file are computed with that function (tools/storyboard_tools.py is a port of camera.js), not by hand.

safe_zones.rule: Nothing essential below y 1651 or right of x 950 in the lower half. Soft clusters may be cropped by the frame; stencil-sharp shapes (man, suns, beads, coin, deed, chest, mosque, rug, flowers, bud) are never cut by a frame edge in a held framing - layout.frame_edge_checks lists them and the checker tests them.

Each key is where the camera has arrived at t. The last segment is ONE slow push 18.90 -> 24.00 with the custom ease inThenLinear(1.0 s): f(u) = u < a ? u*u / (2a(1 - a/2)) : (u - a/2) / (1 - a/2), a = 1.0 / 5.1 - it eases in for one second and then runs at a constant 1.69 % per second through 23.40 and on to 24.00 with no stop anywhere. ACT2_PUSH and ACT2_END are samples of that segment, not keys.
camera_path.moves_in_pauses: Five real moves: 1.60-2.40, 4.17-4.97, 8.07-8.77, 14.27-15.17, 16.03-16.63. Three of them lie entirely inside narration pauses (4.10-4.94, 7.69-8.85, 16.03-16.67), each settled before the next word, and the frame is at rest for every picture word. The two honest exceptions: move 1 runs over the function words «Bil ki» (262 px/s at «Bil», 392 px/s at «ki») and is settled 4 frames before «dünkü»; move 4 is a follow move that tracks the falling hour - it starts after the pop on «saatini», nothing else changes during it, and it is 96 % arrived at «ihtiyat» (147 px/s). Everything else is a hold, a creep under 10 px/s or the one slow push (1.7 % per second). The camera never stops dead: one shared drift runs on every frame of both acts.

palette.note: The catalogue palette is a starting point, not a limit (bible, user update). Technique defines S-050; colours follow the colour script below. Revision 2 adds the rule that every light is painted against something darker (see contrast_targets).

colour_script.key: High-key cool sky (cobalt densest at the top), dark warm-green ground with a mid-green rise, one warm figure. The only warm sky notes are the veil cloud's rim and, from 1.27, a first faint peach glow low at the left.
Left third turns sunset (deep orange, peach, pink), then cools in two passes to lavender and violet-cobalt dusk. It stays dusk for the rest of the film.
Right third is pre-dawn: desaturated lavender-white mist, pale pink. The dashed ring, the course dots and the deed are the only ochre / maroon notes.

Centre column: clear gold, yellow, peach; the rise he stands on lights yellow-green; white flowers on dark leaf rosettes. The sides drop one value step, so only the column is saturated. 11.90-12.10 the blaze settles and a cobalt ring deepens round the sun.
White beads on the cobalt annulus round the gold disc - white on cobalt, never white on primer; one deep-gold hour with a dark-ochre rim. The coin is the most saturated thing on screen.

Right column: a deepened cool sky (lavender, violet-blue, cobalt) round a tall arch of peach and gold with a dense white core and a pink rim. Today's sun and its dial recede one value step. Ochre-brown wood coffer -> ivory mescid with a lead-blue dome; madder-red rug with a glowing niche.

palette.value_rule: The darkest sharp shape in the sky stage is always the man. A matte sponge wall has no glow: every light is painted AGAINST something darker - beads on cobalt, the far light in a deepened sky, the doorway in a maroon frame, the seam on wood, flowers on dark leaves. Glosses are ivory on the dark hedge.

shared_motion.camera_drift: E.driftCamera(cam, t, {seed: 7, amp: 4, period: 6, zoom: 0.002, rot: 0}) applied to EVERY frame of both acts, with absolute video time t
shared_motion.breathing: shoulders dy = 3 * sin(2 * PI * t / 3.4) px, torso scaleY +-0.6 %
shared_motion.halo_breath: halo scale = 1 + 0.03 * sin(2 * PI * t / 4.0); disc itself rigid
shared_motion.flower_sway: flower i: rot = 0.06 * sin(1.1 * t + 1.7 * i) rad, dx = 3 * sin(0.9 * t + 1.7 * i) px (i = 1..6)
shared_motion.clouds: x = x0 + drift_px_per_s * t (layout.clouds: one cloud)
shared_motion.mist: x offset = 4 * t px, wraps inside its bbox
shared_motion.specks: one seeded system 'ambient' (12 specks; white, pale yellow, pink; size 4-9 px; rising slowly up-right), parallax 1.2, alpha 0.8, drawn only in the sky stage: alpha ramps to 0 between screen y 1150 and 1190 in every framing; identical in both acts
shared_motion.rule: All of the above are pure functions of absolute video time and fixed seeds, built ONCE in video/src/shared/ and imported by both act scenes, so frame 12.20 rendered by act1 and by act2 is the same picture. Tomorrow's ring does NOT breathe.

motion_grammar: Dab-ins / dab-outs are stepped: 'on twos' (every 2 frames) or 'on threes'; every pass is listed with the frame time it lands on and with its count (dots, dashes, beads per step).

Everything that travels is eased (cubic in-out; a few named exceptions: quad ease-in for the slip, quart ease-out for the unroll, sine ease-out for the cast). No linear moves except the creeps and the slow push.
Arrivals overshoot 6-10 % and settle in 6-8 frames; departures get a 2-3 frame counter-move (anticipation).
Limbs overlap: upper arm leads, forearm follows 2 frames later, hand 2 frames after that - so no arm move is shorter than 6 frames.

Sponge textures are baked in object space and move / rotate rigidly with their object. Nothing swims, nothing flickers. Shapes that change (lid -> dome, body -> walls) are stencil-mask tweens over a pre-baked texture plus a cross-dab; no sprite is ever stretched by more than 10 %.

The frame is at rest when a picture word lands (checked with the engine's camera maths; the two exceptions are named in the camera path). Stepped dab-ins never happen on a layer that is travelling fast.

At most two synced hits per phrase - its idea and its resolution; everything else is unsynced anticipation or follow-through, and a hold is a real hold. A synced hit leads its word by 2-4 frames and never lags it ('leads_word', checked against timing.json).
One region at a time: while something builds in one column the other column only breathes.

beats.idea: (the painter's hand finishes the world - this is the hook, not a clause)
beats.picture: Never a blank or half-empty frame: frame 0 is already a complete, poster-simple landscape - the cream primer wall carrying the whole sponge-dabbed sky, the far lavender ridge, the dark hedge and the low rise. In ONE stepped pass the foliage gets its leaves and closed buds and the clouds arrive - one of them a large white 'veil' cloud with a peach-gold rim, top centre, hiding today's sun. He stands for five frames before anything else happens: one warm figure, cool sky, dark ground.

beats.idea: The call arrives at him: 'my own self'.
beats.picture: A ring of white-gold dabs appears round him and closes IN on his chest in three steps - a call reaching him, not a glow coming out of him. With the ring his head lifts and his right hand (screen-left arm) rises; it lands flat on his chest just before «nefis», the last dabs of the ring gather under it and are absorbed completely - nothing keeps glowing on him. A quiet hold. Then a first warm glow dabs in low at the left of the sky; his hand leaves his chest and he turns toward it. The turn is made in the film's own technique: the front stencil dabs out while the back stencil dabs in. From now on we see him from behind. The nefs is never a creature, shadow or double: the man himself is the one addressed.

beats.idea: Yesterday is a sun he thinks he holds; it slips out of his hand and sets.

beats.idea: The day you are IN: only where he stands is lit - and he takes it to heart.
beats.picture: He lowers his gaze from the sun to the lit ground he is standing on. The two sides recede one value step - the left duskier, the right mistier - and the two legs of the dotted course dab out from the feet upward: yesterday's and tomorrow's tracks leave, only today remains. On «bil» he straightens with the smallest nod. He never raises his arms or opens his palms to the sun. A hold on the triptych: dusk / day / mist - three days in one sky, one of them lit. Then, in the breath after the sentence, the blaze settles: the outer halo and the light column dab out and the sky round the sun deepens to a cobalt ring - the stage for the hours. The lit rise and his warmth stay.

beats.idea: He casts the hour - and it reaches the true future.
beats.picture: One small, unhurried underhand swing with a half-step toward the mosque: the coin leaves his hand just before «at» and travels a low arc across the gap between the two columns, its clock face toward us the whole way - no flip - slowing as it arrives, so that it is placed, not pitched. Then three links, one after the other, each in its own beat: the niche's own light swells once, softly; the doorway brightens; the far light swells by one pass - the hour has reached the true future. And then stillness: his arm sinks slowly, he stands a half-step nearer, turned toward the mosque; above him the day's dial with its one gap. Settled, alive, serene.

merge_decisions.decision: No raised or opened arms toward the sun. He stands inside the light column, lowers his gaze to the lit ground, nods on «bil».

merge_decisions.decision: 24 round white hour-beads laid on a cobalt annulus by one sweeping clock-hand; the hand waits 0.4 s so that «en az» reads over stillness; one bead turns gold and pops out. The dial, its gap and its hand stay in the sky to the last frame (one value step dimmer from 16.93).
merge_decisions.why: 'Saat' is hour and clock: a hand makes the ring a dial without numerals. White needs cobalt behind it (3.1 : 1; on the primer-rich sky it was 1.2 : 1). Keeping the dial keeps the equation on screen at the punchline: one of the day's 24 hours went there - an hour, not money.

merge_decisions.decision: No flip anywhere. The gold bead floats down unchanged and is MINTED on landing: a beaded rim is stamped round it in his palm, on a frame at rest, at the largest scale; received at chest height.
merge_decisions.why: A mid-air flip during a camera move was invisible, and a flipping coin is a coin toss. Stamping the rim in the hand is one readable press; at chest height the coin is no 'second head' and no offering toward the sun.

merge_decisions.decision: A tall, soft, arch-shaped light rising from beyond the ridge where tomorrow's fog was, with a dense white core set ABOVE where the dome will stand, in a sky that is first deepened round it. Sequenced: ring crumbles on «hakiki» -> right column turns over -> light rises -> brightest on «istikbal». No disc, rays, trees, gate or figure.
merge_decisions.why: A horizon strip is a few dozen pixels in 9:16; a tall column uses the format. Uncertain tomorrow versus certain future becomes one contrast: dashed versus steady. Light can only be painted with darkness round it, and it can only be seen on a frame at rest.

merge_decisions.decision: Five light-beads step down from the light to the plateau and the chest is set up where they touch down; it absorbs three, the dome later absorbs the other two; body under «olunan», lid just before «sandukça-i»; on «uhreviye» only the seam lights.
merge_decisions.why: Cause and effect in one idea: the chest is established by and for the true future. Beads that hang inside the chest or the dome, or that are 'lit' when hidden, were a geometric contradiction; the longest gloss needs the quietest picture.

merge_decisions.decision: A squat wooden savings coffer with straps, lock plate and a barrel lid ajar and glowing from within. No coin slot, no green lid.
merge_decisions.why: A slot beside a mosque reads as a donation box; an ivory box with a green rounded lid captioned 'âhirete ait' can read as a sanduka (draped tomb chest). Built from the mosque's shapes, the morph is still a completion, not a replacement.

merge_decisions.decision: A small generic Anatolian mescid with a lead-blue dome and a pencil minaret, grown in three overlapping moves (lid -> dome, body -> walls with door and windows, minaret as one sprite) from «olan»; crescents pop 3 frames before «mescide»; everything at rest by 20.43.

merge_decisions.decision: No qiyam and no stepping onto the rug. A small cast with a half-step toward the mosque; the coin travels face-on and is placed; then three links, one at a time - niche, doorway, far light - and eight frames of stillness.

merge_decisions.decision: The coin sinks INTO the glowing niche and the niche's own light swells once; nothing is left lying on the rug; it never enters the chest or the mosque; no flip, no ripple rings.
merge_decisions.why: It is an hour deposited at the place of prostration, not money given to a building, not a coin toss and not a wishing well.

tone: Serene, warm, unhurried and exact - a quiet word to one's own self, not a spectacle. The viewer should feel addressed, then relieved.
Hand-made: a painter's sponge and stencils on a primed wall. Stepped dab-ins, rigid cut-outs with beautiful easing, constant small life.
Motion on the breaths, stillness on the words. Each clause gets one picture and time to be read on a phone; holds are real holds.
Respect: the unseen is light only; worship is implied by mosque and seccade, never performed in a hurry; the hour is placed, not thrown.
The hand carries the acting: it loses yesterday, holds nothing of tomorrow, receives one hour, and gives it.
never: No on-screen text of any kind except the four engine glosses. No labels, numerals, script on the deed, coin or mosque.
No visual hit lagging its word; no new picture idea inside a clause beyond the one listed for it; never more than two synced hits per phrase.
Never two solid sun discs in one frame; today's disc never cut by the frame.

No pose that can read as reverence toward the sun: no raised or opened arms, no upturned palms toward it, no head thrown back. The coin is received casually in ONE palm at chest height, never above the shoulder.
The nefs is never drawn as a creature, shadow or double; nothing glows on him after the call.

The true future is never a disc, never has rays, a hard edge, a gate, a figure or recognisable trees (no cypress: in Turkey it says cemetery). It must not look like a sunrise and it never floats above the horizon.
No coin slot, green lid or cloth on the chest (donation box / sanduka). The mescid is never the green-domed mosque of the style reference.

The coin never flips, anywhere (a flip is a coin toss), and there are no ripple rings (a wishing well). It never enters the chest or the mosque and is never left lying on the rug. Its clock-hands are always readable.
The rug never comes out of the door. He never steps onto it (he is wearing shoes) and no prayer posture is attempted.

Nothing light or moving inside the gloss band during a gloss window (leaf stencils there are tone-on-tone); no real camera move while a gloss is at full strength; the hedge lip stays at screen y 1200-1213 while a gloss is up.
Two columns never act at once; no stepped dab-in on a fast-travelling layer; no event on a picture word while the camera is in a real move.

No texture swimming, flicker, per-frame randomness, linear robotic moves, joint gaps, sprite stretching beyond 10 %, card-flip turns, body leans beyond 1 degree, or stencil shapes cut by a frame edge.
No airbrush gradients, outlines, glossy highlights or flat vector fills: every filled area shows sponge pores. No white on primer: every light has its dark.
No music. Sound effects stay under the voice; at most two cues per beat.
